func matcherSetHasExpressionMatcher(set caddyhttp.MatcherSet) bool {
	// Only expressions that reference upstream response placeholders
	// ({rp.*} or {http.reverse_proxy.*}) are treated as response
	// conditions. Expressions that only test the request keep their
	// original meaning: they restrict which requests may be retried
	// after a failed round-trip, and must not make successful
	// responses retryable.
	for _, m := range set {
		me, ok := m.(*caddyhttp.MatchExpression)
		if !ok || me == nil {
			continue
		}
		if strings.Contains(me.Expr, "{rp.") ||
			strings.Contains(me.Expr, "{http.reverse_proxy.") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

		strings.Contains(expr, "'rp.") ||
